summary: Add reactive notes and quick input to Fractal web agent conversations

replay.detail: Presentation-only change; existing note claims remain authoritative.

schema.detail: Uses generated SubjectNote and the independent notes collection without adding agent or mission fields.

rules.detail: Every note reaches its target agent as context, with no audience choice or audience-specific badge. Only own notes offer archive.

compatibility.detail: Fractal web follows notes and forwards generated note write routes through the authenticated gateway. Unsupported gateways show explicit unavailability.

manual.detail: Enter plain text in an agent conversation and confirm to send agent context. Enter sends and Shift+Enter adds a line; the visible counter measures the 1024-byte limit. Escape and failed writes keep the draft for retry. Expand the notes badge to read notes and archive your own. Storybook compares inline and keyboard-popover input in narrow/wide light/dark views.

recovery.detail: Failed writes retain the draft. The notes stream publishes changes and archives; the UI never polls or fabricates counts from conversation rows.
